Constructs grouping of party owners on actual layouts, source inventories and compositions, preserving the exact memory operator under canonical isometries. A source whose endpoints become equal is retained as a local preparation of its original vector. If every original source is internal to one side, the actual two restrictions give a tensor product of contractions. The selective preparation and chronological partial gate expansion remain separate obligations.
